_comment: stage-architect settings. Copied to ~/.leanscale-gtm/stage-architect.json by /stage-architect:setup. Edit by hand any time - every key is documented by the _<key>_help line under it. Nothing here is read from the plugin directory at run time.
_crm_help: salesforce | hubspot. Only used to pick default field names; the analysis itself is vendor-neutral.
_pipelines_in_scope_help: Pipeline ids to analyse. Salesforce orgs usually have one implicit pipeline ('default'); HubSpot orgs usually have several. The pipeline holding the most deals becomes the primary and gets the full analysis; the rest get headline numbers only.
_history_lookback_days_help: How far back to pull opportunities and stage history. 540 days (18 months) is the Salesforce field-history retention floor - going further back silently returns partial history and inflates every early-stage rate.
_min_cohort_size_help: Minimum number of RESOLVED deals a stage needs before its conversion rate is allowed to participate in the non-discriminating-pair test. Below this, two stages can look identical purely from small numbers. Raise it if your deal count is high; do not lower it below ~20.
_equivalence_band_pp_help: Two adjacent stages are only called non-discriminating if their forward conversion rates are within this many percentage points AND the difference is not statistically significant. Both conditions must hold - significance alone is not enough at large n.
_significance_alpha_help: Two-proportion z-test threshold. p above this means 'we cannot tell these two stages apart'.
_zero_dwell_hours_help: A stage whose MEDIAN time-in-stage is under this many hours is a zero-dwell stage: deals are dragged through it for process compliance, not because anything happened.
_skip_rate_flag_pct_help: Flag a stage when this share or more of the deals that got past it never entered it.
_regression_flag_pct_help: Flag backwards movement when this share or more of deals moved to an earlier stage at least once.
_zombie_p90_multiple_help: Flag a stage when its p90 time-in-stage is this many times its median - the signature of a stage that quietly parks dead deals.
_loss_reason_fill_floor_pct_help: Minimum acceptable fill rate on the closed-lost reason field. Below this, your loss analysis is a survey of the reps who bothered.
_loss_reason_dominance_pct_help: If one loss-reason value covers this share or more of populated losses, the picklist is not discriminating - it is a shrug with a dropdown.
_history_coverage_floor_pct_help: Minimum share of in-window opportunities that must have at least one stage-history row before conversion rates are treated as fully measured.
_sales_accepted_stage_help: The stage at which sales formally accepts the deal as real. Everything before it is marketing/SDR yield; everything after it is sales execution. Named exactly as it appears in the CRM.
_lead_lifecycle_exists_help: True if a separate lead/contact lifecycle runs ahead of opportunity stages (MQL -> SQL -> SAL). When true the run pulls it and reports how much of the funnel dies at or before sales acceptance.
_stages_are_meant_to_be_help: buyer_verifiable | rep_asserted. What the team INTENDS. Captured so the report can hold the written definitions to the standard the team says it wants, rather than to ours.

Discovery.written_definition: Rep has had a first call and believes there is a fit.

Qualification.written_definition: Budget, authority, need and timeline confirmed by the rep.

_stage_definitions_help: The team's OWN written definition of each stage, verbatim from the wiki or enablement doc, plus whether that sentence can be verified by a buyer-produced artifact ('buyer_verifiable') or only asserted by the rep ('rep_asserted'). Stages with no entry here are reported as undefined.
_believed_conversion_rates_help: What the team BELIEVES converts, captured during setup before any measurement is shown. headline_metric is 'overall_win_rate' or 'win_rate_from_sales_accepted'. The delta between these numbers and the measured ones is the primary deliverable of this plugin - do not backfill these from a report.
_fields_help: Field API names on the opportunity/deal record. Salesforce defaults shown. HubSpot equivalents: dealname, dealstage, amount, createdate, closedate, hs_lastmodifieddate, closed_lost_reason, pipeline, hubspot_owner_id. Leave a value out and the analyser falls back through a candidate list.
_material_deal_floor_help: Ignore deals below this amount. null inherits the shared value from ~/.leanscale-gtm/profile.json, which is where it belongs.
_org_name_help: Only used when ~/.leanscale-gtm/profile.json is absent (for example when running against the bundled fixtures). Normally leave null.
